name: DDO 113 (Hubble)
blurb: DDO 113, a dwarf satellite galaxy of NGC 4214, seen by Hubble.
label: ddo113-hubble
story: This small companion of the galaxy NGC 4214 has stopped forming stars and is virtually free of gas. Astronomers think it was starved: the cold gas that once flowed into it was cut off.

claims.text: DDO 113 is a satellite of NGC 4214
DDO 113 has stopped forming stars and is virtually gas-free
Strangulation, the cutting off of cold gas inflows, likely quenched it
DDO 113 is a low-luminosity dwarf in the NGC 4214 association; also known as UGCA 276
Observed by the ACS Nearby Galaxy Survey
